title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — September 14, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.2 (Peaked September 13, 2026 at 18:01 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 350 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)

Nice and quiet out there. 🤍☀

A few small sunspots and broad dark coronal regions are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clear CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
